# ScopeExit

The header `include/ScopeExit/ScopeExit.h` is copied unchanged from
[SergiusTheBest/ScopeExit](https://github.com/SergiusTheBest/ScopeExit), commit
`616be054ffbbfa76927de92b39afae5db0afea4b`.

Only the ScopeExit header is included; it depends on the C++ standard library.
